headline: ReTrace Converts LLM Agent Runs Into Code Workflows
body: Relying on language models for every step of repeated tasks increases expenses and delays. ReTrace solves this by converting process instructions and past execution logs into reusable code.
caption:
ReTrace Converts LLM Agent Runs Into Code Workflows

Relying on language models for every step of repeated tasks increases expenses and delays. ReTrace solves this by converting process instructions and past execution logs into reusable code.

Source: arXiv
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14492v1

title: ReTrace: Distilling Tool-Using Agents into Planner-Free Workflows
